title: Using anndataR
text: ’s quick example use {anndataR}. First, download h5ad file. Read h5ad file memory: Read h5ad file disk: View structure: Access AnnData slots:
code: library(anndataR)  h5ad_path <- system.file("extdata", "example.h5ad", package = "anndataR") adata <- read_h5ad(h5ad_path) adata <- read_h5ad(h5ad_path, to = "HDF5AnnData") adata #> AnnData object with n_obs × n_vars = 50 × 100 #>     obs: 'Float', 'FloatNA', 'Int', 'IntNA', 'Bool', 'BoolNA', 'n_genes_by_counts', 'log1p_n_genes_by_counts', 'total_counts', 'log1p_total_counts', 'leiden' #>     var: 'String', 'n_cells_by_counts', 'mean_counts', 'log1p_mean_counts', 'pct_dropout_by_counts', 'total_counts', 'log1p_total_counts', 'highly_variable', 'means', 'dispersions', 'dispersions_norm' #>     obsm: 'X_pca', 'X_umap' #>     varm: 'PCs' #>     layers: 'counts', 'csc_counts', 'dense_X', 'dense_counts' #>     obsp: 'connectivities', 'distances' dim(adata$X) #> [1]  50 100 adata$obs[1:5, 1:6] #>         Float FloatNA Int IntNA  Bool BoolNA #> Cell000 42.42     NaN   0    NA FALSE  FALSE #> Cell001 42.42   42.42   1    42  TRUE     NA #> Cell002 42.42   42.42   2    42  TRUE   TRUE #> Cell003 42.42   42.42   3    42  TRUE   TRUE #> Cell004 42.42   42.42   4    42  TRUE   TRUE adata$var[1:5, 1:6] #>          String n_cells_by_counts mean_counts log1p_mean_counts pct_dropout_by_counts total_counts #> Gene000 String0                44        1.94          1.078410                    12           97 #> Gene001 String1                42        2.04          1.111858                    16          102 #> Gene002 String2                43        2.12          1.137833                    14          106 #> Gene003 String3                41        1.72          1.000632                    18           86 #> Gene004 String4                42        2.06          1.118415                    16          103

title: Create an in-memory AnnData object. — AnnData
text: X Either NULL observation × variable matrix dimensions consistent obs var. obs Either NULL data.frame columns containing information observations. NULL, n_obs×0 data frame automatically generated. var Either NULL data.frame columns containing information variables. NULL, n_vars×0 data frame automatically generated. layers Either NULL named list, element observation × variable matrix dimensions consistent obs var. obsm obsm slot used store multi-dimensional annotation arrays. must either NULL named list, element matrix n_obs rows arbitrary number columns. varm varm slot used store multi-dimensional annotation arrays. must either NULL named list, element matrix n_vars rows arbitrary number columns. obsp obsp slot used store sparse multi-dimensional annotation arrays. must either NULL named list, element sparse matrix dimension length n_obs. varp varp slot used store sparse multi-dimensional annotation arrays. must either NULL named list, element sparse matrix dimension length n_vars. uns uns slot used store unstructured annotation. must either NULL named list. shape Shape tuple (#observations, #variables). Can provided X obs var provided.

what: An AnnData object has the following slots
title: anndataR: AnnData interoperability in R — anndataR-package
text: Access using $ operator. Example: adata$obs. X: matrix observations variables. obs: data frame observations. var: data frame variables. obs_names: Names observations (alias rownames(obs)). var_names: Names variables (alias rownames(var)). layers: named list matrices dimensions X. obsm: named list matrices number rows obs. varm: named list matrices number rows var. obsp: named list sparse matrices number rows columns number observations. varp: named list sparse matrices number rows columns number variables. uns: named list unstructured annotations.

code: from_Seurat(   seurat_obj,   output_class = c("InMemoryAnnData", "HDF5AnnData"),   assay_name = NULL,   x_mapping = NULL,   layers_mapping = NULL,   obsm_mapping = NULL,   varm_mapping = NULL,   obsp_mapping = NULL,   varp_mapping = NULL,   uns_mapping = NULL,   ... )

title: Convert a Seurat object to an AnnData object — from_Seurat
text: seurat_obj Seurat object converted. output_class Name AnnData class. Must one "HDF5AnnData" "InMemoryAnnData". assay_name name assay converted. NULL, default assay used (SeuratObject::DefaultAssay()). x_mapping mapping Seurat layer AnnData X slot. NULL, data copied X slot. layers_mapping named list mapping layer names names layers Seurat object. item list must character vector length 1. See section "$layers mapping" details. obsm_mapping named list mapping reductions names reductions Seurat object. item list must vector length 2. See section "$obsm mapping" details. varm_mapping named list mapping PCA loadings names PCA loadings Seurat object. item list must character vector length 1. See section "$varm mapping" details. obsp_mapping named list mapping graph names names graphs Seurat object. item list must character vector length 1. See section "$obsp mapping" details. varp_mapping named list mapping miscellaneous data names data Seurat object. item list must named list one two elements. See section "$varp mapping" details. uns_mapping named list mapping miscellaneous data names data Seurat object. item list must named list one two elements. See section "$uns mapping" details. ... Additional arguments passed generator function.

text: named list map AnnData layers Seurat layers. item list must character vector length 1. $X key maps X slot. Example: layers_mapping = list(counts = "counts", foo = "bar"). NULL, internal function from_Seurat_guess_layers used guess layer mapping follows: Seurat layers copied AnnData layers name. means AnnData X slot NULL (empty). want copy data X slot, must define layer mapping explicitly.

title: Convert a Seurat object to an AnnData object — from_Seurat
text: named list map Seurat reductions AnnData $obsm. item list must vector length 2, name corresponds name resulting $obsm slot, values correspond location data Seurat object. Example: obsm_mapping = list(pca = c("reductions", "pca"), umap = c("reductions", "umap")). NULL, internal function from_Seurat_guess_obsms used guess obsm mapping follows: Seurat reductions prefixed X_ copied AnnData $obsm.

title: Convert a Seurat object to an AnnData object — from_Seurat
text: named list map Seurat reduction loadings AnnData $varm. item list must character vector length 2, name corresponds name resulting $varm slot, value corresponds location data Seurat object. Example: varm_mapping = list(PCs = c("reductions", "pca"). NULL, internal function from_Seurat_guess_varms used guess varm mapping follows: name PCA loadings copied name.

title: Convert a Seurat object to an AnnData object — from_Seurat
text: named list map Seurat graphs AnnData $obsp. Example: obsp_mapping = list(nn = "connectivities"). NULL, internal function from_Seurat_guess_obsps used guess obsp mapping follows: Seurat graphs copied $obsp name.

title: Convert a Seurat object to an AnnData object — from_Seurat
text: named list map Seurat miscellaneous data AnnData $varp. name item corresponds resulting $varp slot, value item must fector corresponds location data Seurat object. Example: varp_mapping = list(foo = c("misc", "foo")). NULL, internal function from_Seurat_guess_varps used guess varp mapping follows: data mapped $varp.

title: Convert a Seurat object to an AnnData object — from_Seurat
text: named list map Seurat miscellaneous data AnnData uns. item list must character length 2. first element must "misc". second element name data corresponding slot. Example: uns_mapping = list(foo = c("misc", "foo")). NULL, internal function from_Seurat_guess_uns used guess uns mapping follows: Seurat miscellaneous data copied uns name.
